      • [Compatibility] Designed For iPhone 14 Pro & This Cover Supports Wireless Charging.

      Product description

      This Zapcase Back Cover is Designed For iPhone 14 Pro. It has an excellent fit and finish. All cut-outs and buttons are precisely designed to access all your device's features. It gives Edge to Edge protection for your Mobile that gives complete protection in the event of falls and bumps. The Suede Fabric inside the Case protects phone's body from scratches and provides extra cushion to the case. The Soft Silicon TPU is Made from Imported High-Grade TPU Material that absorbs Shocks and also gives a Premium Matte Touch & feel. It is Professionally Designed with Raised Upper Lips to protect your Screen and Camera from Everyday ware and tare / scratches. The Case has minimalistic design with Grooves on the back giving a Superior Grip and Premium Feel. This cover supports Wireless charging. The case has openings precisely made for the charger port / dock connector, headset jack and speaker which allow you full access to all the functions on your device. This case is available in multiple colour options to choose your taste. The case is technically tested for fitment and Drop Protection.
